_record: Birth-year discrepancy noticed during the P0 search. USER-DIRECTED: 1981 stands as the authoritative birth year. This record exists so the finding is not rediscovered and acted on by a later session.

authoritative_birth_data.note: Confirmed by the subject after the 1982 discrepancy below was reported.

discrepancy_found.summary: Two documents in an employer archive state a date of birth of 9 December 1982; the chart is built on 9 December 1981. Day and month agree; the year differs by one.

documents.authority: Unique Identification Authority of India, digitally signed letter
documents.reading: 9 December 1982 (unambiguous: the date field is DD/MM/YYYY and the value cannot be read as MM/DD because 09 <= 12 and 12 <= 12; in UIDAI format the day is first)
documents.confidence: HIGH — the document is digitally signed by UIDAI

documents.authority: Employer payroll record, Espirit Technologies Pvt Ltd, employee code ESPSD323
documents.confidence: MEDIUM — an employer-entered field, not a primary identity record

discrepancy_found.why_it_matters: A one-year birth error places the Moon in a different nakshatra, which changes the dasha lord, the dasha balance and every mahadasha boundary. It would invalidate both the chart and the NO-GO baseline, which were computed on 1981.
discrepancy_found.resolution: NOT ADOPTED — the subject was shown this evidence and directed that 1981 stands.
discrepancy_found.plausible_benign_explanation: An employer-entered and a UIDAI-entered year can both carry a transcription error; the subject's own recollection is the tiebreak the subject chose to exercise.
discrepancy_found.action_required_of_future_sessions: DO NOT change the birth year on the strength of these two documents alone. They are recorded, not adopted. If a THIRD independent primary document states 1981, this record should be updated to show the conflict resolved.

do_not: Do not alter calculate_kundali.py's birth input from this record.
Do not regenerate v5 or the frozen datasets on the basis of this record.
Do not cite this record as evidence that 1981 is documentarily confirmed — it is USER-CONFIRMED, which is a different and weaker kind of claim.
